name: secrets
description: Store credentials safely and reference them as s/ names — never inline a raw key anywhere. Load before configuring anything that needs an API key or token.

content.inline:
## Secrets
- set `{name, value}` stores a credential encrypted, scoped to you.
- Reference it ANYWHERE an op takes a credential as `s/<name>` (e.g. `apiKey: "s/OPENAI_API_KEY"`). References resolve at invocation time and are never persisted raw.
- Delete via the workspace: `v/ops/covia/delete` on path `s/<name>`. List names with `v/ops/covia/list` on `s`.
- extract `{name}` returns the raw value — capability-gated; avoid unless genuinely required.

Rules:
- NEVER put a raw key in agent config, op inputs you store, or workspace values — agent configs persist unredacted on the lattice. Job records redact known secret fields, but `s/` references are the supported pattern.
- Secret names are per-user; an agent acting as you resolves your secrets.
- MCP server auth and HTTP credentials should also be `s/` references.
